name: Memento Zako ☆彡
source:
Minamiya Miya, a girl who struggled to like herself,
spent her days in a haze, unable to find her identity.

Then one day,
she gained the ability to transform into a magical girl,
bestowing upon her immense individuality.

However, numerous hardships awaited Minamiya on her path.

The encroaching claws of monsters,
rumors of a mysterious organization,
and the major disadvantages concealed within being a magical girl.

Through her adventures, will Minamiya find her identity?
And will she learn to love herself?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27715]Freem![/url]]
